name: Raqqa

routes.outcome: First-party GDCA domain was found, but the site redirected to /maintainenece/ and exposed no viewer or service configuration.
Anonymous TLS-verified GET redirected to https://gdca.gov.sy/maintainenece/; response was a 353-byte maintenance page. No login, CAPTCHA, certificate bypass, or private token was attempted.
Anonymous request timed out after 20 seconds. No response body, API route, or parcel data was obtained.

First-party GDCA Telegram channel states that the Raqqa real-estate-affairs directorate was visited to assess work and needs for reopening after a twelve-year interruption. This is local registry-custodian evidence, not parcel geometry evidence.

Official SANA report says electronic registry services currently cover Damascus, Daraa, Quneitra, and Latakia, with expansion to other Syrian governorates planned; it describes future registry-document and survey-plan services but does not expose a Raqqa parcel API or map.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No public parcel response was obtained; no CRS or reprojection was performed.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: No native parcel identity was returned. No synthetic identity was created.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Official GDCA website and electronic-service landing route only; no anonymous parcel endpoint was exposed.

localCustodianAssessment: The first-party GDCA channel explicitly identifies the Directorate of Real Estate Affairs in Raqqa and its service-reopening work. registryFound is true for local custodian evidence. The SANA report is national service-progression evidence and does not prove public Raqqa parcel coverage.

qualification.reason: A local registry custodian is evidenced, but no public parcel adapter contract, safe native identity, geometry response, schema, CRS, coverage, or anonymous API was established.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [35.9534864536779, 39.0115827606218] was preserved and was not shifted.

No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.

uncertainty: The Raqqa local registry custodian is supported by first-party GDCA channel evidence. The official GDCA web domain was in maintenance and the electronic-service route timed out. No public parcel map/API, field schema, CRS, licensing, update cadence, or anonymous geometry response could be verified. Packet complete for attempt 1; runtime remains held.
